label: r1
issues: Body is a lumpy cluster of exposed slopes/studs, not the smooth clean ovoid of the concept
Beak is a stubby 2x2 stud-out block instead of a tapered orange wedge; reads as a box, not a bill
No visible legs/feet — only a tiny orange tile flush with the ground instead of standing orange legs
Head lacks the rounded crown and eye placement is inconsistent (eye on both sides, floating)
Black tail patch reads as a black blob on the body side rather than a tail at the rear
Neck is a plain black column with visible studs/gaps, too uniform and attached with a visible gap to the body
Exposed studs and raw plate edges everywhere break the polished official-set look
Body too small relative to neck/head; overall silhouette doesn't read as a goose at a glance
distilled: A LEGO model of a chunky standing goose with a curved white body, black head and neck, and an orange beak, built from stacked bricks and plates with a smooth sloped back.
